【57】Managemenit

【58】Referral for medical management is necessary. All cases demonstrating positive findings and those in whorn there is a high suspicion must be reported to local and state public health departments. This is best left to the treating physician. Because of the development of TB-resistant organisms， the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has developed a new strategy that involves muitipic drug application and monitoring. Isoniazid and rifampin are supported by other medications such as pyra-zinamide and streptomycin.

【60】Cassic Presentation

【62】Cause

【63】There is a varicty of causes， including upper respiratory infection， sinusitis， allergies， drugs (e.g.， ACE inhibitors)， smnoking， and environmental pollutants. Chronic irritation of the pharyngeal andtra-cheal mnembranes initiates the cough reflex. Postnasal drip is by far the most comrnon cause of chronic cough.

【65】Classically， there will be a cobblestonc appearanec of the posterior mucosa；however， this is a nonspecific finding. Primarily， it is necessary to identify the underlying cause through a history. If there is asso-LC：ciated nasal congestion， a suspicion of sinusitis warrants sinus evaluation with skull radiographs.

【67】The patient is instructed to avoid any identifiable triggering stimuli. OTC nasal decongestants or an-tihistamines used for a short course may be effective. If a prescribed medication is the suspect， such as an ACE inhibitor， referral back to the prescribing physician is necessary. Failure to respond to conservative measures requires referral for prescribed decongestants or antihistamines. An evaluation of sinusitis is warranted if this treatment trial fails. There is a nasal-specific technique used by some chiropractors for the treatment of sinusitis； however， it should be used only by thosc with special training and experience. Physicians often will use a trial of antibioties first before more invasive nrocedures.

【68】**Chronic Bronchitis**

【69】Classic Presentation

【70】The patient complains of a chronic productive cough for 3 months or more in at least 2 consecutive years. The patient is a smoker.

【71】Cause

【72】Airway blockage occurs as a result of metaplasia of cells， smooth mmiscle hypertrophy and increased mucus production. It appears that chronic cigarette smoking is the major risk factor. However， air pol-lution， respiratory infections， and allergies have all been implicated as contributory. Chronic bron-chitis and emphysema often coexist in the later stages of COPD.

【73】Evaluat on

【74】Initially， the patient is asymptomatic. Unlike the purely emphysematous patient， the patient with chronic bronchitis is often overweight and may show some degrec of cyanosis. Dyspnea is primarily exertion related. The prominent feature at presentation is a chronic productive cough. Auscultation often will reveal rhonci or wheezes. Chest films may show an increase in markings with an associated cardiomegaly. ECG changes may indicate right ventricular hypertrophy.

【75】Management

【76】The primary treatment is the same for prevention： cessation of smoking and avoidance of any known irritants such as dusts or other pollitants. Compiications such as associated asthmatic reaction or in-fections warrant comanagement with a medical physician.

【40】**Pneumonia**

【41】Classic Presentation

【42】The patient appears to have a respiratory infection with an associated productive cough and fever. The specificity of the presentation is increased by knowing whether the patient is immunocompromised， elderly， alcoholic， or a chronic smoker.

【43】Cause

【44】Inhalation or aspiration of oropharyngeal secretions containing microorganisms leads to lung infec-tion. There are numerous causes， each with its own clinical presentation and treatment. Generalization will be made to assist in the distinction of pneumonia from other causes of respiratory infection.

【45】Evaluate

【46】In general， if the pneumonia is bacterial， the patient will appear to be more sick， with a higher fever and possibly chills. This is not always true， especially in the elderly and immunocompromised. Viral causes are usually more mild with a low-grade fever； however， the symptoms are more prolonged. Radiographs may be helpful， but there is no consistent pattern in all cases of any one cause. However， abnormal findings on a chest radiograph， such as lobar consolidation， patchy infiltrates， or pleural ef-fusion， are characteristic of pneumonia and would warrant referral. Rales are often heard.

【47】Management

【48】Antibiotic treatment is necessary with bacterial pneumonia. Viral causes are not responsive. However， mycoplasma pneumonia may be responsive because it is an atypical organism.

【52】**Cause**

【53】Inhalation of mycoplasma tuberculosis will result in widespread lymphatic or hematogenous spread and an immune response that results in granulomatous walling-off of the organism. Primary TB rarely progresses to symptomatic presentat ised.；ion unless the patient is immunocompromised， such as the elderly or those with HTV infection (with or without AIDS).16 An increase in the number ofTB cases is due to those with HIV， immigrants， and prisoners. Dissemination throughout the lungs is often called miliary TB.

【54】Fvaluation

【55】The patient presentation is not always classic. Patients known to be infected with HTV， immigrants， and the elderly should always be monitored for the development of pulmonary or other organ in-volvement. Auscultation may reveal posttussive apical rales. Radiographs may demonstrate nodules or infiltrates in the apical or posterior segments in the upper lobes. However， there is much variation. Calcified areas (Ghon lesion) indicate healed primary TB. The definitive diagnostic tool is sputum stain (Kinyoun or Ziehl-Neelsen) and culture. Fiberoptic bronchoscopy may be necessary if not enough sputum is available. Skin testing is unable to distinguish active， current disease from past in-fection. The multiple-puncture test is used for group screening or the Mantoux test is used for indi-vidual testing.

【72】Airway blockage occurs as a result of metaplasia of cells， smooth mmiscle hypertrophy and increased mucus production. It appears that chronic cigarette smoking is the major risk factor. 【1】_Causes due to lesions outside the bowel， although adjacent_ _to it_ Adhesions and hernias， the commonest causes of intestinal obstruction， belong in this category. Prior to World War II， most of the large series describing intesti-nal obstruction described hernias as the commonest cause. Since then， in the developed world， hernias tend to be repaired early on and the total numbers of opera-tions on the abdomen for various reasons have increased considerably. As a consequence， adhesions are now the commonest cause of obstruction in the developed world. In developing countries， however， hernias remain by far the commonest cause of intestinal obstruction. Unlike obstructed hernias， which give rise to symptoms instantly， adhesions may give rise to an acute obstruc-tion， as it did in the patient described in Case history 8， or they may give rise to subacute episodes of obstruc-tion. Adhesions may develop shortly after surgery or at times years after. An inflammatory or pyogenic compli-cation in the abdomen， such as a perforation of a viscus or an abscess， is more prone to the development of adhe-sions. Talc， used in surgical gloves in the old days， when spilled in the peritoneal cavity， has been known to give rise to a very aggressive and chronic form of adhesive‘peritonitis’ that in effect causes bowel obstruction in much the same way as do adhesions.

【2】_Causes due to lesions in the wall of the bowel_ Crohn's disease would be the commonest cause in this group in the West and tuberculosis in many developing coun-tries. Crohn’s disease may cause either subacute or acute obstruction. It is worth remembering that both ischemic and post-radiation strictures may occur many years after the initial ischemic or radiation injury. Both intussusception and volvulus may be regarded as lesions’ in the wall. Intussusception is much com-moner in children. However， occasionally a lymphoma or carcinoma may be at the leading edge of an intus-susception in adults. Intussusception of a Meckel's diverticulum may also occur， patients presenting with intermittent pain and gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Volvulus in the West is less common than in several developing countries and almost always involves the colon， the sigmoid colon being much commoner than the cecum .

【37】**_Functional obstruction (ileus， pseudo-obstruction)_**

【38】Functional obstruction of the bowel is due to impaired gut motility in the absence of a mechanical obstructive lesion and may involve the small or large intestine. As shown in Table 9.4 functional obstruction may occur acutely as with peritonitis or secondary to an electrolyte disorder.

【39】A poorly understood cause of acute functional obstruction is the so-called Ogilvie’s syndrome. Here colonic motility is impaired and the patient develops distension that can become quite massive. It tends to occur mostly in middle-aged or elderly persons with other medical or surgical conditions . For some reason， it is common after orthopedic surgery and spinal surgery . Abdominal distension can be so marked that it can make breathing in the supine position difficult. On examination the abdomen is tympanitic and bowel sounds are generally heard. Bowel sounds may even be very active as a consequence of the normally functioning small intestine making an effort to move contents stagnating in the paralyzed colon. The cecum is the most vulnerable part of the large bowel and is always at risk for perforation. Most gastroenterologists will agree that in acute functional obstruction a cecal size of 12 cm or greater warrants colonoscopic decompression. More recently prostig-mine has been shown to be of benefit in this setting and may be tried first in patients who do not have a contraindication to the drug.

【53】**Cecal volvulus**

Cecal volvulus is much less common than sigmoid volvulus (< 1% of all intestinal obstructions). Again， abdominal pain and distension， often with vomiting， are the symptoms. The abdomen， though distended， is usually less so than with a sigmoid volvulus， because the colon distal to the cecum does not contain air. The twisted cecum is frequently seen and palpated centrally，|删除0换行|a little to the left of the midline， and has a tympanitic note on percussion. The right iliac fossa on palpation feels empty.

【55】It is important to make an early diagnosis， since on occasion the ileocecal valve is very competent and a closed loop obstruction may result. When that happens， the cecum proximal to the torsion becomes filled with fluid， and gaseous distension will then not be evident on a plain radiograph. Closed loop obstruc-tions are dangerous， since the venous flow to the bowel is impeded by the compression from the distended bowel and ischemia and gangrene result ultimately in perforation. When peritoneal signs develop in a patient with intestinal obstruction， a closed loop obstruction must be suspected.

【59】**Paraesophageal hiatus hernia and gastric volvulus**

A sliding hiatus hernia  is a very common entity and occurs as a result of a laxity of the phrenoesophageal membrane. The phrenoes-ophageal membrane surrounds the lower end of the esophagus and anchors it to the diaphragm. Heartburn is the commonest symptom that patients with a sliding|删除0换行|hiatus hernia complain of. In contrast， a paraesophageal hiatus hernia is an uncommon entity and results from a break in the phrenoesophageal membrane. Since the gastroesophageal junction is fixed to the preaortic fascia and the median arcuate ligament， the gastroesophageal junction remains in the abdomen. As a consequence， a pouch of peritoneum containing the fundus of the stomach rolls into the chest adjacent to the esophagus. The paraesophageal hiatus hernia is therefore also known by the term rolling hiatus bernia， in contrast to the common sliding variety. A paraesophageal hiatus hernia is illustrated in Figure 9.29.

【61】Owing to the fixity of the gastroesophageal junction mentioned above， the part of the stomach that has her-niated into the chest can undergo torsion， resulting in a gastric volvulus. A gastric volvulus can be either organoaxial (60%) or mesenterioaxial or mesoaxial(30%). The remaining 10% are a combination of the two. The axes of the stomach along which these torsions develop are shown in Figure 9.30.

【62】A gastric volvulus may give rise to distension in the epigastrium and the patient makes unproductive efforts at vomiting. There can be a great deal of chest or upper abdominal discomfort. When an effort is made to pass a nasogastric tube， this is not possible. It can also be suspected at endoscopy. The endoscopist is unable to locate the pylorus and easily forms loops within the stomach. A gastric volvulus may perforate.

【90】PCNs were considered previously to be a rare entity， being identified during transabdominal ultrasonography in 0.2 % of studies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[16\]</u>. Currently， PCNs have become a surprisingly common clinical problem， accounting for 10-15 % of all cystic lesions of the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[17， 18\]</u>. The vast majority (~90 %) of PCNs are serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs)， primary mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pan-creas (MCNs)， or IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 19， 20\]</u> . Other rare types of PCNs(solid pseudopapillary neoplasms， cystic neuroendocrine neoplasms， etc.) account for about 10 % of all cases of PCNs.

【91】SCNs account for over 30 % of PCNs and for 1 % of non-endocrine pancreatic neoplasms. SCNs arise anywhere in the pancreas， with most cases occurring in the pancreatic head 通用删除6(英):<u>\[21， 23\]</u> . In a multicenter study from Japan， SCNs were located in the pancreatic head， body， tail， and uncinate process in 39， 35， 22， and3 % of patients， respectively 通用删除6(英):<u>\[22\]</u>. In a study from the Massachusetts General Hospital， Tseng et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u> reviewed 106 patients with SCNs of the pan-creas， 75 % of whom were females. 【56】Over the last three decades， pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCNs) are being appreci-ated and recognized with increasing frequency， primarily as a result of increased awareness of these neoplasms and their natural history and the widespread avail-ability and extensive use of ever improving modalities of cross-sectional imaging通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. Commonly， PCNs are diagnosed incidentally during investigation for often unrelated and nonspecific abdominal complaints using state-of-the art abdominal imaging. The use of the term PCN encompasses a histologically heterogenous group of neoplasms with a wide spectrum of biologic behavior， ranging from com-pletely benign to potentially malignant， to carcinoma in situ， to frankly invasive and malignant 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In 1978， Compagno and Oertel were the first to recognize the crucial distinction between the serous and the mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pancreas by explaining the importance of identifying the mucinous neoplasms because of their overt or latent malignant potential 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 4\]</u>. Since then， the interest in PCNs increased markedly， especially so with the recognition of the importance and preva-lence of intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs).

In 5-10 % of patients， they may involve the pancreas diffusely as multicentric IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[32\]</u>. IPMNs are classified as main duct IPMN， branch duct IPMN arising only in side branches off the main pan-creatic duct， or mixed IPMN arising in both the main duct and the side branches. While main duct IPMNs  are more common in men， branch duct IPMNs occur more commonly in women 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33\]</u>.

【94】The more unusual PCNs represent about 10 % of all PCNs. Solid pseudopapil-lary neoplasms (SPNs) occur almost exclusively (~90 %) in young women (21-33 years of age) and account for 1-3.5 % of PCNs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9， 34， 35\]</u>； SPNs may occur anywhere throughout the pancreas. Cystic degeneration of ductal adenocarcinoma accounts for 0.8 % of all PCNs， while cystic pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms account for about 7.3 % of all PCNs and may be associated with MEN1 syndrome.

【54】**Introduction to Pancreatic Cystic Neoplasms**

【55】人名段删除-1:<u>George H. Sakorafas， Vassileios Smyrniotis， and Michael G. Sarr</u>

【56】Over the last three decades， pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCNs) are being appreci-ated and recognized with increasing frequency， primarily as a result of increased awareness of these neoplasms and their natural history and the widespread avail-ability and extensive use of ever improving modalities of cross-sectional imaging通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. Commonly， PCNs are diagnosed incidentally during investigation for often unrelated and nonspecific abdominal complaints using state-of-the art abdominal imaging. The use of the term PCN encompasses a histologically heterogenous group of neoplasms with a wide spectrum of biologic behavior， ranging from com-pletely benign to potentially malignant， to carcinoma in situ， to frankly invasive and malignant 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In 1978， Compagno and Oertel were the first to recognize the crucial distinction between the serous and the mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pancreas by explaining the importance of identifying the mucinous neoplasms because of their overt or latent malignant potential 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 4\]</u>. Since then， the interest in PCNs increased markedly， especially so with the recognition of the importance and preva-lence of intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs).

【57】Nowadays， PCNs represent a common and often difficult problem in clinical practice， because of the increase in their detection in asymptomatic patients and our still immature understanding of some aspects of their biologic behavior. This

Management of patients with PCNs can be challenging and varies considerably among the various subtypes of PCNs. Accurate classification of pancreatic cystic lesions is of crucial importance， because premalignant lesions will require resection and/or surveillance， malignant lesions require resection， and others that are benign or indolent can be observed. Appropriate classification and therapeutic decision-making are based mainly on the presenting symptoms and radiologic findings， often without actual histologic tissue. Suspicious features indicating underlying malig-nancy or malignant potential should be identified and are of particular importance for selecting appropriate treatment. The risk of overtreatment (unnecessary pancre-atectomy) should be balanced carefully with the risk of undertreatment (missing the opportunity to cure a potentially curable malignant or premalignant disease)通用删除6(英):<u>\[5\]</u>. Unfortunately， despite the availability of many sophisticated diagnostic tools， accu-rate preoperative diagnosis is often not possible 通用删除6(英):<u>\[6\]</u>； this uncertainty emphasizes the problems and challenges in treating patients with PCNs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[7\]</u>. The aim of this mono-graph is to summarize and critically analyze currently available data regarding opti-mal management of these fascinating PCNs.**

【74】**Incidence and Epidemiology of Pancreatic Cystic Neoplasms**

【75】人名段删除-1:<u>George H. Sakorafas， Vassileios Smyrniotis， and Michael G. Sarr</u>

【76】Asymptomatic cystic lesions of the pancreas are not uncommon； indeed， their inci-dence is about 1 in 100 hospitalized patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. These cystic lesions represent a diverse spectrum of disease， encompassing traumatic， infectious， congenital， or neoplastic etiologies . The incidence of cystic lesions of the pancreas increases with age 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2， 3\]</u> and depends on the method used for their detection. In an autopsy study， Kimura et al. found that the incidence of pancreatic cystic lesions of all types was 24 % and that these lesions were distributed equally throughout the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In a population of 24，039 patients undergoing computed tomography(CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) during the period 1995-2002， Spinelli et al. identified pancreatic “cysts"in 1.2 % of patients， and 0.7 % of the sample had no history of pancreatitis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[4\]</u>. Using the newer， multi-detector CT， unexpected， unre-lated， and incidental pancreatic“cysts”were identified with a prevalence of 2.6 %通用删除6(英):<u>\[5\]</u>. The prevalence is even greater when MRI is used， ranging from 2.4 to 13.5 %通用删除6(英):<u>\[6\]</u>. Zhang et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[7\]</u> estimated that the prevalence of pancreatic “cysts" (many being<1 cm) in patients undergoing MRI for non-pancreatic diseases was nearly 20 %. Girometti et al. reported the prevalence of pancreatic “cysts” to be 44.7 % in patients undergoing MRCP for non-pancreatic indications 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8\]</u>. There is evidence that many of these pancreatic cystic lesions are unrecognized and have been underdiagnosed， because a substantial percentage (up to 70 %!) of pancreatic cystic lesions are not

【87】Modified from Sakorafas et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[36\]</u>

【88】reported in the original radiology report 通用删除6(英):<u>\[6\]</u>. The increasing prevalence of inciden-tally diagnosed pancreatic cystic lesions has also been reported in the surgical litera-ture， where an increase by 28 % over 33 years has been documented 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>.

Increased awareness and improved sensitivity of imaging is associated not only with increasing detection rates but also with decreasing lesion size 通用删除6(英):<u>\[10-13\]</u>. These factors only increase the clinical challenges involved in determining which patients require either more investigation， surveillance， or resection. Ferrone et al. compared data for the periods 1997-2002 and 2004-2007 and noted that the proportion of asymptomatic patients being referred to PCNs increased from 36 to 71 %； interest-ingly， the proportion undergoing resection decreased from 80 to 50%通用删除6(英):<u>\[11\]</u>.Recently， it has been reported that the median size of cystic lesions of the pancreas in patients|删除0换行|being referred for lesions sent for evaluation halved from 4 to 2 cm over the last5-year period 通用删除6(英):<u>\[14， 15\]</u>. Ferrone and colleagues reported a similar decrease in the size of lesions referred from 3.3 to 2.7 cm 通用删除6(英):<u>\[11\]</u>.

【90】PCNs were considered previously to be a rare entity， being identified during transabdominal ultrasonography in 0.2 % of studies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[16\]</u>. Currently， PCNs have become a surprisingly common clinical problem， accounting for 10-15 % of all cystic lesions of the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[17， 18\]</u>. The vast majority (~90 %) of PCNs are serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs)， primary mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pan-creas (MCNs)， or IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 19， 20\]</u> . Other rare types of PCNs(solid pseudopapillary neoplasms， cystic neuroendocrine neoplasms， etc.) account for about 10 % of all cases of PCNs.

【91】SCNs account for over 30 % of PCNs and for 1 % of non-endocrine pancreatic neoplasms. SCNs arise anywhere in the pancreas， with most cases occurring in the pancreatic head 通用删除6(英):<u>\[21， 23\]</u> . In a multicenter study from Japan， SCNs were located in the pancreatic head， body， tail， and uncinate process in 39， 35， 22， and3 % of patients， respectively 通用删除6(英):<u>\[22\]</u>. SCNs typically occur in women over the age of60， with a female to male ratio of 70：30 通用删除6(英):<u>\[24， 25\]</u>. In a study from the Massachusetts General Hospital， Tseng et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u> reviewed 106 patients with SCNs of the pan-creas， 75 % of whom were females. Mean age at presentation was 62 years， but the mean age of males was >7 years older than that of females， and males had larger tumors at presentation， suggesting a delay in diagnosis in men 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u>.

【92】MCNs occur almost exclusively (>95 %) in middle-aged/perimenopausal females通用删除6(英):<u>\[26-28\]</u>. Literature in the past suggested a much more common prevalence in men than we appreciate currently； in retrospect， most of these lesions in men were IPMNs and not MCNs. This topic will be discussed below. The incidence of MCNs peaks in the fifth decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[29， 30\]</u>. MCNs arise in the body and tail of the pancreas in approximately 95 % of patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>.

【93】IPMNs represent an increasingly recognized neoplasm. In a large， retrospective study of resected pancreatic cystic lesions， IPMNs were the most commonly resected cystic lesion accounting for about 2 % of cases 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. IPMNs occur slightly more commonly in men between the ages of 50 and 80 (older than patients with MCNs) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8， 31\]</u>. While IPMNs usually arise in the head of the pancreas， they can occur anywhere in the pancreas， as well as arising in multiple locations in 20-30 %of cases when looked for with diligence 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>. In 5-10 % of patients， they may involve the pancreas diffusely as multicentric IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[32\]</u>. IPMNs are classified as main duct IPMN， branch duct IPMN arising only in side branches off the main pan-creatic duct， or mixed IPMN arising in both the main duct and the side branches. While main duct IPMNs  are more common in men， branch duct IPMNs occur more commonly in women 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33\]</u>.

【94】The more unusual PCNs represent about 10 % of all PCNs. Solid pseudopapil-lary neoplasms (SPNs) occur almost exclusively (~90 %) in young women (21-33 years of age) and account for 1-3.5 % of PCNs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9， 34， 35\]</u>； SPNs may occur anywhere throughout the pancreas. Cystic degeneration of ductal adenocarcinoma accounts for 0.8 % of all PCNs， while cystic pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms account for about 7.3 % of all PCNs and may be associated with MEN1 syndrome.

【56】Over the last three decades， pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCNs) are being appreci-ated and recognized with increasing frequency， primarily as a result of increased awareness of these neoplasms and their natural history and the widespread avail-ability and extensive use of ever improving modalities of cross-sectional imaging通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. Commonly， PCNs are diagnosed incidentally during investigation for often unrelated and nonspecific abdominal complaints using state-of-the art abdominal imaging. The use of the term PCN encompasses a histologically heterogenous group of neoplasms with a wide spectrum of biologic behavior， ranging from com-pletely benign to potentially malignant， to carcinoma in situ， to frankly invasive and malignant 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In 1978， Compagno and Oertel were the first to recognize the crucial distinction between the serous and the mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pancreas by explaining the importance of identifying the mucinous neoplasms because of their overt or latent malignant potential 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 4\]</u>. Since then， the interest in PCNs increased markedly， especially so with the recognition of the importance and preva-lence of intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs).

【90】PCNs were considered previously to be a rare entity， being identified during transabdominal ultrasonography in 0.2 % of studies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[16\]</u>. Currently， PCNs have become a surprisingly common clinical problem， accounting for 10-15 % of all cystic lesions of the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[17， 18\]</u>. The vast majority (~90 %) of PCNs are serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs)， primary mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pan-creas (MCNs)， or IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 19， 20\]</u> . Other rare types of PCNs(solid pseudopapillary neoplasms， cystic neuroendocrine neoplasms， etc.) account for about 10 % of all cases of PCNs.

【91】SCNs account for over 30 % of PCNs and for 1 % of non-endocrine pancreatic neoplasms. SCNs arise anywhere in the pancreas， with most cases occurring in the pancreatic head 通用删除6(英):<u>\[21， 23\]</u> . In a multicenter study from Japan， SCNs were located in the pancreatic head， body， tail， and uncinate process in 39， 35， 22， and3 % of patients， respectively 通用删除6(英):<u>\[22\]</u>. SCNs typically occur in women over the age of60， with a female to male ratio of 70：30 通用删除6(英):<u>\[24， 25\]</u>. In a study from the Massachusetts General Hospital， Tseng et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u> reviewed 106 patients with SCNs of the pan-creas， 75 % of whom were females. Mean age at presentation was 62 years， but the mean age of males was >7 years older than that of females， and males had larger tumors at presentation， suggesting a delay in diagnosis in men 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u>.

【92】MCNs occur almost exclusively (>95 %) in middle-aged/perimenopausal females通用删除6(英):<u>\[26-28\]</u>. Literature in the past suggested a much more common prevalence in men than we appreciate currently； in retrospect， most of these lesions in men were IPMNs and not MCNs. This topic will be discussed below. The incidence of MCNs peaks in the fifth decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[29， 30\]</u>. MCNs arise in the body and tail of the pancreas in approximately 95 % of patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>.

【93】IPMNs represent an increasingly recognized neoplasm. In a large， retrospective study of resected pancreatic cystic lesions， IPMNs were the most commonly resected cystic lesion accounting for about 2 % of cases 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. IPMNs occur slightly more commonly in men between the ages of 50 and 80 (older than patients with MCNs) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8， 31\]</u>. While IPMNs usually arise in the head of the pancreas， they can occur anywhere in the pancreas， as well as arising in multiple locations in 20-30 %of cases when looked for with diligence 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>. In 5-10 % of patients， they may involve the pancreas diffusely as multicentric IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[32\]</u>. IPMNs are classified as main duct IPMN， branch duct IPMN arising only in side branches off the main pan-creatic duct， or mixed IPMN arising in both the main duct and the side branches. While main duct IPMNs  are more common in men， branch duct IPMNs occur more commonly in women 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33\]</u>.

【94】The more unusual PCNs represent about 10 % of all PCNs. Solid pseudopapil-lary neoplasms (SPNs) occur almost exclusively (~90 %) in young women (21-33 years of age) and account for 1-3.5 % of PCNs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9， 34， 35\]</u>； SPNs may occur anywhere throughout the pancreas. Cystic degeneration of ductal adenocarcinoma accounts for 0.8 % of all PCNs， while cystic pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms account for about 7.3 % of all PCNs and may be associated with MEN1 syndrome.

【56】Over the last three decades， pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCNs) are being appreci-ated and recognized with increasing frequency， primarily as a result of increased awareness of these neoplasms and their natural history and the widespread avail-ability and extensive use of ever improving modalities of cross-sectional imaging通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. Commonly， PCNs are diagnosed incidentally during investigation for often unrelated and nonspecific abdominal complaints using state-of-the art abdominal imaging. The use of the term PCN encompasses a histologically heterogenous group of neoplasms with a wide spectrum of biologic behavior， ranging from com-pletely benign to potentially malignant， to carcinoma in situ， to frankly invasive and malignant 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In 1978， Compagno and Oertel were the first to recognize the crucial distinction between the serous and the mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pancreas by explaining the importance of identifying the mucinous neoplasms because of their overt or latent malignant potential 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 4\]</u>. Since then， the interest in PCNs increased markedly， especially so with the recognition of the importance and preva-lence of intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs).

【90】PCNs were considered previously to be a rare entity， being identified during transabdominal ultrasonography in 0.2 % of studies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[16\]</u>. Currently， PCNs have become a surprisingly common clinical problem， accounting for 10-15 % of all cystic lesions of the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[17， 18\]</u>. The vast majority (~90 %) of PCNs are serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs)， primary mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pan-creas (MCNs)， or IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 19， 20\]</u> . Other rare types of PCNs(solid pseudopapillary neoplasms， cystic neuroendocrine neoplasms， etc.) account for about 10 % of all cases of PCNs.

【91】SCNs account for over 30 % of PCNs and for 1 % of non-endocrine pancreatic neoplasms. SCNs arise anywhere in the pancreas， with most cases occurring in the pancreatic head 通用删除6(英):<u>\[21， 23\]</u> . In a multicenter study from Japan， SCNs were located in the pancreatic head， body， tail， and uncinate process in 39， 35， 22， and3 % of patients， respectively 通用删除6(英):<u>\[22\]</u>. SCNs typically occur in women over the age of60， with a female to male ratio of 70：30 通用删除6(英):<u>\[24， 25\]</u>. In a study from the Massachusetts General Hospital， Tseng et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u> reviewed 106 patients with SCNs of the pan-creas， 75 % of whom were females. Mean age at presentation was 62 years， but the mean age of males was >7 years older than that of females， and males had larger tumors at presentation， suggesting a delay in diagnosis in men 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u>.

【92】MCNs occur almost exclusively (>95 %) in middle-aged/perimenopausal females通用删除6(英):<u>\[26-28\]</u>. Literature in the past suggested a much more common prevalence in men than we appreciate currently； in retrospect， most of these lesions in men were IPMNs and not MCNs. This topic will be discussed below. The incidence of MCNs peaks in the fifth decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[29， 30\]</u>. MCNs arise in the body and tail of the pancreas in approximately 95 % of patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>.

【93】IPMNs represent an increasingly recognized neoplasm. In a large， retrospective study of resected pancreatic cystic lesions， IPMNs were the most commonly resected cystic lesion accounting for about 2 % of cases 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. IPMNs occur slightly more commonly in men between the ages of 50 and 80 (older than patients with MCNs) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8， 31\]</u>. While IPMNs usually arise in the head of the pancreas， they can occur anywhere in the pancreas， as well as arising in multiple locations in 20-30 %of cases when looked for with diligence 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>. In 5-10 % of patients， they may involve the pancreas diffusely as multicentric IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[32\]</u>. IPMNs are classified as main duct IPMN， branch duct IPMN arising only in side branches off the main pan-creatic duct， or mixed IPMN arising in both the main duct and the side branches. While main duct IPMNs  are more common in men， branch duct IPMNs occur more commonly in women 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33\]</u>.

【94】The more unusual PCNs represent about 10 % of all PCNs. Solid pseudopapil-lary neoplasms (SPNs) occur almost exclusively (~90 %) in young women (21-33 years of age) and account for 1-3.5 % of PCNs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9， 34， 35\]</u>； SPNs may occur anywhere throughout the pancreas. Cystic degeneration of ductal adenocarcinoma accounts for 0.8 % of all PCNs， while cystic pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms account for about 7.3 % of all PCNs and may be associated with MEN1 syndrome.

【56】Over the last three decades， pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCNs) are being appreci-ated and recognized with increasing frequency， primarily as a result of increased awareness of these neoplasms and their natural history and the widespread avail-ability and extensive use of ever improving modalities of cross-sectional imaging通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. Commonly， PCNs are diagnosed incidentally during investigation for often unrelated and nonspecific abdominal complaints using state-of-the art abdominal imaging. The use of the term PCN encompasses a histologically heterogenous group of neoplasms with a wide spectrum of biologic behavior， ranging from com-pletely benign to potentially malignant， to carcinoma in situ， to frankly invasive and malignant 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In 1978， Compagno and Oertel were the first to recognize the crucial distinction between the serous and the mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pancreas by explaining the importance of identifying the mucinous neoplasms because of their overt or latent malignant potential 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 4\]</u>. Since then， the interest in PCNs increased markedly， especially so with the recognition of the importance and preva-lence of intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs).

Accurate classification of pancreatic cystic lesions is of crucial importance， because premalignant lesions will require resection and/or surveillance， malignant lesions require resection， and others that are benign or indolent can be observed. 【76】Asymptomatic cystic lesions of the pancreas are not uncommon； indeed， their inci-dence is about 1 in 100 hospitalized patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. These cystic lesions represent a diverse spectrum of disease， encompassing traumatic， infectious， congenital， or neoplastic etiologies . The incidence of cystic lesions of the pancreas increases with age 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2， 3\]</u> and depends on the method used for their detection. In an autopsy study， Kimura et al. found that the incidence of pancreatic cystic lesions of all types was 24 % and that these lesions were distributed equally throughout the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In a population of 24，039 patients undergoing computed tomography(CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) during the period 1995-2002， Spinelli et al. identified pancreatic “cysts"in 1.2 % of patients， and 0.7 % of the sample had no history of pancreatitis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[4\]</u>. Using the newer， multi-detector CT， unexpected， unre-lated， and incidental pancreatic“cysts”were identified with a prevalence of 2.6 %通用删除6(英):<u>\[5\]</u>. 【90】PCNs were considered previously to be a rare entity， being identified during transabdominal ultrasonography in 0.2 % of studies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[16\]</u>. Currently， PCNs have become a surprisingly common clinical problem， accounting for 10-15 % of all cystic lesions of the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[17， 18\]</u>. The vast majority (~90 %) of PCNs are serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs)， primary mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pan-creas (MCNs)， or IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 19， 20\]</u> . Other rare types of PCNs(solid pseudopapillary neoplasms， cystic neuroendocrine neoplasms， etc.) account for about 10 % of all cases of PCNs.

【91】SCNs account for over 30 % of PCNs and for 1 % of non-endocrine pancreatic neoplasms. SCNs arise anywhere in the pancreas， with most cases occurring in the pancreatic head 通用删除6(英):<u>\[21， 23\]</u> . In a multicenter study from Japan， SCNs were located in the pancreatic head， body， tail， and uncinate process in 39， 35， 22， and3 % of patients， respectively 通用删除6(英):<u>\[22\]</u>. SCNs typically occur in women over the age of60， with a female to male ratio of 70：30 通用删除6(英):<u>\[24， 25\]</u>. In a study from the Massachusetts General Hospital， Tseng et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u> reviewed 106 patients with SCNs of the pan-creas， 75 % of whom were females. Mean age at presentation was 62 years， but the mean age of males was >7 years older than that of females， and males had larger tumors at presentation， suggesting a delay in diagnosis in men 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u>.

【92】MCNs occur almost exclusively (>95 %) in middle-aged/perimenopausal females通用删除6(英):<u>\[26-28\]</u>. Literature in the past suggested a much more common prevalence in men than we appreciate currently； in retrospect， most of these lesions in men were IPMNs and not MCNs. This topic will be discussed below. The incidence of MCNs peaks in the fifth decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[29， 30\]</u>. MCNs arise in the body and tail of the pancreas in approximately 95 % of patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>.

【93】IPMNs represent an increasingly recognized neoplasm. In a large， retrospective study of resected pancreatic cystic lesions， IPMNs were the most commonly resected cystic lesion accounting for about 2 % of cases 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. IPMNs occur slightly more commonly in men between the ages of 50 and 80 (older than patients with MCNs) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8， 31\]</u>. While IPMNs usually arise in the head of the pancreas， they can occur anywhere in the pancreas， as well as arising in multiple locations in 20-30 %of cases when looked for with diligence 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>. In 5-10 % of patients， they may involve the pancreas diffusely as multicentric IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[32\]</u>. IPMNs are classified as main duct IPMN， branch duct IPMN arising only in side branches off the main pan-creatic duct， or mixed IPMN arising in both the main duct and the side branches. While main duct IPMNs  are more common in men， branch duct IPMNs occur more commonly in women 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33\]</u>.

【94】The more unusual PCNs represent about 10 % of all PCNs. Solid pseudopapil-lary neoplasms (SPNs) occur almost exclusively (~90 %) in young women (21-33 years of age) and account for 1-3.5 % of PCNs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9， 34， 35\]</u>； SPNs may occur anywhere throughout the pancreas. Cystic degeneration of ductal adenocarcinoma accounts for 0.8 % of all PCNs， while cystic pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms account for about 7.3 % of all PCNs and may be associated with MEN1 syndrome.

【56】Over the last three decades， pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCNs) are being appreci-ated and recognized with increasing frequency， primarily as a result of increased awareness of these neoplasms and their natural history and the widespread avail-ability and extensive use of ever improving modalities of cross-sectional imaging通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. Commonly， PCNs are diagnosed incidentally during investigation for often unrelated and nonspecific abdominal complaints using state-of-the art abdominal imaging. The use of the term PCN encompasses a histologically heterogenous group of neoplasms with a wide spectrum of biologic behavior， ranging from com-pletely benign to potentially malignant， to carcinoma in situ， to frankly invasive and malignant 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In 1978， Compagno and Oertel were the first to recognize the crucial distinction between the serous and the mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pancreas by explaining the importance of identifying the mucinous neoplasms because of their overt or latent malignant potential 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 4\]</u>. Since then， the interest in PCNs increased markedly， especially so with the recognition of the importance and preva-lence of intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms (IPMNs).

【76】Asymptomatic cystic lesions of the pancreas are not uncommon； indeed， their inci-dence is about 1 in 100 hospitalized patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. These cystic lesions represent a diverse spectrum of disease， encompassing traumatic， infectious， congenital， or neoplastic etiologies . The incidence of cystic lesions of the pancreas increases with age 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2， 3\]</u> and depends on the method used for their detection. In an autopsy study， Kimura et al. found that the incidence of pancreatic cystic lesions of all types was 24 % and that these lesions were distributed equally throughout the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[2\]</u>. In a population of 24，039 patients undergoing computed tomography(CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) during the period 1995-2002， Spinelli et al. identified pancreatic “cysts"in 1.2 % of patients， and 0.7 % of the sample had no history of pancreatitis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[4\]</u>. Using the newer， multi-detector CT， unexpected， unre-lated， and incidental pancreatic“cysts”were identified with a prevalence of 2.6 %通用删除6(英):<u>\[5\]</u>. Increased awareness and improved sensitivity of imaging is associated not only with increasing detection rates but also with decreasing lesion size 通用删除6(英):<u>\[10-13\]</u>. These factors only increase the clinical challenges involved in determining which patients require either more investigation， surveillance， or resection. Ferrone et al. compared data for the periods 1997-2002 and 2004-2007 and noted that the proportion of asymptomatic patients being referred to PCNs increased from 36 to 71 %； interest-ingly， the proportion undergoing resection decreased from 80 to 50%通用删除6(英):<u>\[11\]</u>.Recently， it has been reported that the median size of cystic lesions of the pancreas in patients|删除0换行|being referred for lesions sent for evaluation halved from 4 to 2 cm over the last5-year period 通用删除6(英):<u>\[14， 15\]</u>. Ferrone and colleagues reported a similar decrease in the size of lesions referred from 3.3 to 2.7 cm 通用删除6(英):<u>\[11\]</u>.

【90】PCNs were considered previously to be a rare entity， being identified during transabdominal ultrasonography in 0.2 % of studies 通用删除6(英):<u>\[16\]</u>. Currently， PCNs have become a surprisingly common clinical problem， accounting for 10-15 % of all cystic lesions of the pancreas 通用删除6(英):<u>\[17， 18\]</u>. The vast majority (~90 %) of PCNs are serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs)， primary mucinous cystic neoplasms of the pan-creas (MCNs)， or IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[3， 19， 20\]</u> . Other rare types of PCNs(solid pseudopapillary neoplasms， cystic neuroendocrine neoplasms， etc.) account for about 10 % of all cases of PCNs.

【91】SCNs account for over 30 % of PCNs and for 1 % of non-endocrine pancreatic neoplasms. SCNs arise anywhere in the pancreas， with most cases occurring in the pancreatic head 通用删除6(英):<u>\[21， 23\]</u> . In a multicenter study from Japan， SCNs were located in the pancreatic head， body， tail， and uncinate process in 39， 35， 22， and3 % of patients， respectively 通用删除6(英):<u>\[22\]</u>. SCNs typically occur in women over the age of60， with a female to male ratio of 70：30 通用删除6(英):<u>\[24， 25\]</u>. In a study from the Massachusetts General Hospital， Tseng et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u> reviewed 106 patients with SCNs of the pan-creas， 75 % of whom were females. Mean age at presentation was 62 years， but the mean age of males was >7 years older than that of females， and males had larger tumors at presentation， suggesting a delay in diagnosis in men 通用删除6(英):<u>\[25\]</u>.

【92】MCNs occur almost exclusively (>95 %) in middle-aged/perimenopausal females通用删除6(英):<u>\[26-28\]</u>. Literature in the past suggested a much more common prevalence in men than we appreciate currently； in retrospect， most of these lesions in men were IPMNs and not MCNs. This topic will be discussed below. The incidence of MCNs peaks in the fifth decade of life 通用删除6(英):<u>\[29， 30\]</u>. MCNs arise in the body and tail of the pancreas in approximately 95 % of patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>.

【93】IPMNs represent an increasingly recognized neoplasm. In a large， retrospective study of resected pancreatic cystic lesions， IPMNs were the most commonly resected cystic lesion accounting for about 2 % of cases 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9\]</u>. IPMNs occur slightly more commonly in men between the ages of 50 and 80 (older than patients with MCNs) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[8， 31\]</u>. While IPMNs usually arise in the head of the pancreas， they can occur anywhere in the pancreas， as well as arising in multiple locations in 20-30 %of cases when looked for with diligence 通用删除6(英):<u>\[23\]</u>. In 5-10 % of patients， they may involve the pancreas diffusely as multicentric IPMN 通用删除6(英):<u>\[32\]</u>. IPMNs are classified as main duct IPMN， branch duct IPMN arising only in side branches off the main pan-creatic duct， or mixed IPMN arising in both the main duct and the side branches. While main duct IPMNs  are more common in men， branch duct IPMNs occur more commonly in women 通用删除6(英):<u>\[33\]</u>.

【94】The more unusual PCNs represent about 10 % of all PCNs. Solid pseudopapil-lary neoplasms (SPNs) occur almost exclusively (~90 %) in young women (21-33 years of age) and account for 1-3.5 % of PCNs 通用删除6(英):<u>\[9， 34， 35\]</u>； SPNs may occur anywhere throughout the pancreas. Cystic degeneration of ductal adenocarcinoma accounts for 0.8 % of all PCNs， while cystic pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms account for about 7.3 % of all PCNs and may be associated with MEN1 syndrome.

【0】nd abdominal muscles held tight

【1】    *   Never strike the knee to the floor

【2】*   Repeat 10-30 times as recommended

【3】    *   Repeat with your opposite foot behind you

【4】*   Additional difficulty:

【5】    *   Hold at the lowest angle/depth of lunge for 2/5/7/10 seconds

【6】    *   Raise 3/4s up, and then lower

【7】    *   Repeat

【8】The squat 通用删除1(英):<u></u>:

【9】*   Stand with feet more than shoulders width apart and the toes pointed out ten degrees

【10】*   Roll the hips backward, as if you were sitting in a chair, while keeping your pelvic and abdominal muscle contracted

【11】*   The arms are held across your chest as the trunk is taken into a forward lean 20 degrees

【12】    *   Bend both knees to comfort

【13】    *   Keep the pressure through your heels

【14】*   Repeat 10-30 times as recommended

【15】*   Additional difficulty:

【16】    *   Hold at the lowest angle/depth of squat for 2/5/7/10 seconds

【17】    *   Raise 3/4s up, and then lower

【18】    *   Repeat

【19】Unilateral standing with knee flexion 通用删除1(英):<u></u>:

【20】*   Stand on one foot

【21】*   Contract the pelvic floor musculature, abdominals, and gluteals

【22】*   Do not lean to the side

【23】*   While keeping your knees parallel, flex the non-standing knee

【24】*   Hold for 3/5/10 seconds, and repeat 10/20/30 times

【25】Unilateral standing with hip abduction 通用删除1(英):<u></u>:

【26】*   Stand on one foot

【27】*   Contract the pelvic floor musculature, abdominals,and gluteals

【28】*   While keeping erect, raise one foot to the side; do not lean

【29】*   Hold for 3/5/10 seconds, and repeat 10/20/30 times

【30】Standard abdominals 通用删除1(英):<u></u>:

【31】*   While supine with knees bent/feet flat, the hands are to be placed under head/neck

【32】    *   Keep the chin tucked in as the head and chest are raised toward the ceiling (not towards the knees)

【33】    *   Hold for 3/5/10 seconds, repeat 20/15/10x

【34】Oblique abdominals 通用删除1(英):<u></u>:

【35】*   While supine, place hands under head/neck

【36】*   Rotate your knees to the left 45 degrees left

【37】*   Keep the chin tucked in as the head and chest are raised toward the ceiling

【38】    *   Once at the uppermost of motion, twist to the right

【39】    *   Maintain the twist and elevate towards the ceiling a little more

【40】    *   Hold for 3/5/10 seconds lower your right shoulder toward the floor, all whilst maintaining the rotation

【41】    *   Repeat 20/15/10x

【42】    *   Repeat on the opposite side

【43】Abdominal bridge with twist 通用删除1(英):<u></u>:

【44】*   Lie on the right side, resting on the right elbow/forearm

【45】    *   Keep the elbow directly under the shoulder so that the elbow is perpendicular to the floor and your top hand is on your head, elbow to ceiling.

【46】*   The body is held straight as the right hip is raised from the floor

【47】    *   Keep the right foot and right elbow/forearm on the floor

【48】*   At the apex of motion, twist the left shoulder toward the floor

【49】    *   Do not allow the hip/pelvis to sway or rotate

【50】*   Repeat 10-30 repetitions

【51】*   Repeat on the left side

【52】Abdominal press 通用删除1(英):<u></u>:

【53】*   Lie on one side, hand supporting your head, opposite hand on the floor.

【54】*   Keep the top hip forward 10 degrees.

【55】*   Press through left hand and raise your right shoulder and head.

【56】*   Keep the body’s orientation perpendicular to the floor.

【57】*   Hold for 3 seconds, and do 10-30 repetitions.

【58】*   Repeat on the opposite side.

【59】Abdominal float 通用删除1(英):<u></u>:

【60】*   Lie on your side, head supported by left hand.

【61】*   Right hand is on the table in front of the chest for support.

【62】    *   Keep the top hip forward 10 degrees.

【63】*   Keeping the legs straight, and your left hip to the floor, elevate the legs together towards the ceiling.

【64】    *   Keep the body’s orientation 10 degrees forward of perpendicular to the floor.

【65】*   Hold for 3 seconds, and repeat 10-30 repetitions.

【66】*   Repeat on the opposite side.

【1】Polycystic kidney may be of two types： infantile form and adult form. In the infantile form， an autosomal recessive disease， the kidney(in fact both kidneys) is enlarged， the whole parenchyma being filled with fusiform or cylindrical cysts. Cysts are found in liver， pancreas， bile duct， and lung as well. Radiology shows radially-aligned renal parenchyma opacifications in the shape of streaks， widened calyces and visible contrast medium in the cortex.

【2】In the adult form (a misnomer because it manifests in childhood as well)， an autosomal dominant disease， the subject presents with a renal swelling (rather on the other side also) accompanied by， at times， drag-ging pain in the loin， hematuria or uremia， and pale urine (oflow specif-ic gravity) showing albumin and casts. All through the parenchyma， the kidney shows cysts. Accompanying features may include an intracranial aneurysm. Radiology shows calyces which are elongated and bizarrely distorted with terminal clubbing， making sponge-like appearance.

【3】Renal calculus may occasionally be responsible for an enlarged kid-ney. Remaining manifestations include colicky abdominal pain， hema-turia， recurrent urinary infections， passing of the calculus and urethral obstruction. X-ray establishes the diagnosis.

【4】Perinephric abscess manifests with diffuse renal swelling， erythe-ma， edema and tenderness of the flank. The individual is toxic， having pyrexia of unknown origin. The lumbar spine shows scoliosis with the concavity towards the involved side. Movements of the spine to the opposite side is usually painful. There may be limp and fixed flexion of the hip. Radiology shows displacement of the affected kidney and ureter with obliteration of the psoas shadow.

【5】Wilms' tumor， also called nephroblastoma， may be responsible for a huge painless renal lump in the right upper quadrant. Hematuria is rare. If metastases has occurred， associated symptoms will be seen depending upon the organ(s) involved. Radiology shows a soft tissue opacity displacing the gut in the area normally occupied by the kid-ney， and distortion of calyces (spiderleg deformity).

【6】**Mass in Abdomen**

【7】Neuroblastoma， a malignant tumor arising from adrenal medulla or sympathetic ganglia (so， not a renal growth in actuality)， may produce a lump that not only fills the right hypochondrium but also goes down and to the left， crossing the midline. The kidney is in reality pushed upward by this mass which is hard and fixed. Remaining manifesta-tions depend upon the extent of the growth. Fever， bone pain anemia and weight loss are common. Subcutaneous nodules， adrenal masSes with involvement of the bone marrow， hepatomegaly from massive in-filtration of the liver， paraplegia， paroxysmal hypertension and propto-sis secondary to retroperitoneal deposits may occur.

【8】Radiology shows displacement of one of the kidneys by a suprarenal mass. Gross skeletal metastases may also be detected.

【9】Urine examination revealsan excessive excretion of cate-cholamine and/or their metabolites， vanilmandelic acid (VMA) and cystythionine.

【10】Bone marrow may show secondary deposits， i.e. neuroblasts， which may simulate leukemia.

【11】**Liver and Subphrenic Space**

【12】Refer details given in connection with the right hypochondrium.

【13】**Stomach， Duodenum and Gut**

【14】Congenital hypertrophic pyloric stenosis， occurring in infants about3 to 5 weeks old， may be responsible for epigastric fullness， gastric waves moving from left to right and a palpable olive-shaped lump about the size of the thumb. The classical story is that the infant， usually a first born male， begins to vomit. Within 30 minutes， vomit-ing becomes forceful and projectile. He is constantly hungry and fails to thrive. Occasionally， greenish stools (starvation diarrhea)， gastric hemorrhage or jaundice may be present. Dehydration， electrolyte imbalance (especially alkalosis， hypokalemia and hyponatremia) and tetanic spasms may complicate the picture. Barium meal study shows gross narrowing and elongation of pylorus. The stomach is markedly distended， with abnormal retention of barium， and there is increased intensity of peristaltic waves.

【15】Intussusception (though usually its lump is palpable in the right hypochondrium) may cause a lump in the epigastric region in some cas-es. In the latter situation， its long axis is directed transversely rather than cephalocaudally.

【16】Trichobezoar Some infants and children， especially if having be-havioral problems， may get into the practice of pulling out the head hair and swallow the material. In due course， this chronic practice may lead to collection of a lot of hair in the stomach which becomes pal-pable as a big lump， the so-called trichobezoar or hairball， particularly after meals. The lump gives a soft crackling feeling when palpated. Symptoms include indigestion， dyspepsia and epigastric discomfort， more so after meals. Areas of alopecia， secondary to trichotilomania， over head in an emotionally disturbed or mentally retarded child may suggest the diagnosis.

Barium meal study shows a lump outlined by barium. Intestinal|删除0换行|tuberculosis In hyperplastic tuberculosis， contracted|删除0换行|transverse mesocolon may pull the transverse colon to the lower part of the epigastrium， leading to a palpable mass and fullness in the epigastric region.

【18】In tuberculosis， the omentum may get rolled up to form a transverse ridge in the epigastric region. A mass of lymph nodes with adherent intestinal coils may be felt in the epigastrium.

【19】Pseudopancreatic cyst may form a smooth rounded fluctuating lump in the epigastrium. It is a collection of fluid in the lesser sac of the peri-toneal cavity. A trauma or inflammation figure among the causes.

【20】Barium meal shows that the lump is situated behind the stomach.

【21】人名段删除-1:<u>**Aorta**</u>

【22】A lump in the epigastrium with characteristic expansile pulsation may well be aneurysm of upper part of the abdominal aorta.

【23】**Mass in Abdomen**

【24】人名段删除-1:<u>**Lymph Nodes**</u>

【25】Enlarged lymph nodes， of whatsoever etiology， may cause palpable lump in the epigastric region.

【26】Except for the splenic lump， intra-abdominal mass in this region merits about the same components as given in connection with the right hypochondrium.

【27】A detailed discussion on differential diagnosis of splenomegaly will be found in Chapter 55. A comprehensive list of its causes is as under.

【28】_InfectionsMalaria， kala-azar， enteric fever， tuberculosis， bru-_ cellosis， intrauterine infections， septicemia， infective endocarditis， infectious mononucleosis， histoplasmosis，coma viral fevers.

【29】Hematogenous diseases Hemolytic anemias， erythroblastosis fe-talis， nutritional anemia， hypersplenism， thrombocytopenic purpura.

【30】Congestive splenomegaly Congestive cardiac failure， cirrhosis， hepatic， portal or splenic vein thrombosis， constrictive pericarditis.

【31】Inborn errors ofmetabolism Glycogen storage disease， Gaucher’s disease， Niemann-Pick disease， gargoylism， amyloidosis， hemo-siderosis， xanthomatosis， cystinosis， cystic fibrosis.

【65】**Mouth-Breathing**

【66】Mouth-breathing is a common observation in pediatric practice. It is responsible for several secondary adverse effects， including dryness of the mouth and lips and their proneness to fissuring and infection.

【89】By the term， nystagmus， is meant involuntary rapid movements(horizontal， vertical， rotatory， or mixed) of the eyeball， usually causing no or little disturbance to the subject. 【66】Mouth-breathing is a common observation in pediatric practice. It is responsible for several secondary adverse effects， including dryness of the mouth and lips and their proneness to fissuring and infection.

Accompanying manifestations may include dryness of the mucous membrane of the mouth and lips， persistent rhinitis， pharyngitis， snor-ing， nasal voice， offensive breath， impaired taste， bad smell， harass-ing cough， impaired hearing and chronic otitis media. Eventually， the child may develop dull expression with open mouth and maloccluded teeth-the so-called adenoid facies. His school performance too suffers.

【70】In a suspected case， digital palpation， indirect visualization with a pharyngeal mirror or fiberoptic bronchoscope， or lateral pharyngeal X-ray may help in clinching the diagnosis.

【65】**Mouth-Breathing**

【66】Mouth-breathing is a common observation in pediatric practice. It is responsible for several secondary adverse effects， including dryness of the mouth and lips and their proneness to fissuring and infection.

【67】In a given case， find out if the child mouth-breathes just out of habit or he has an obstructive nasal problem. Does he have persistent or recurrent upper respiratory infection? Does he sneeze a lot?Any headache，hyposmia， or postnasal discharge?

【68】Physical examination should， in particular， exclude adenoids， polyp， foreign body， deviated septum and allergy.

【69】Adenoidal hypertrophy may interfere with the passage of air through the nose， resulting in mouth-breathing， especially during sleep when the child lies supine. When gross adenoidal hypertrophy is present， the child develops a tendency to keep the mouth open during day al-so. Accompanying manifestations may include dryness of the mucous membrane of the mouth and lips， persistent rhinitis， pharyngitis， snor-ing， nasal voice， offensive breath， impaired taste， bad smell， harass-ing cough， impaired hearing and chronic otitis media. Eventually， the child may develop dull expression with open mouth and maloccluded teeth-the so-called adenoid facies. His school performance too suffers.

【70】In a suspected case， digital palpation， indirect visualization with a pharyngeal mirror or fiberoptic bronchoscope， or lateral pharyngeal X-ray may help in clinching the diagnosis.

【75】A hypertensive mother on reserpine may pass on the drug to the baby and cause nasal obstruction and mouth-breathing.

【76】Mouth-breathing may accompany nasal allergy which occurs as a re-sult of changed reactivity of nasal mucosa to a variety of substances. Two types are known： seasonal and perennial. In seasonal allergy， al-so termed hay fever or pollinosis， the antigen (allergen) is an inhalant such as pollens of flowers， weeds， trees or grass. In perennial allergy， the allergen may be an inhalant or ingestant like egg white， fish， milk， etc. as also a drug， bacteria or perfume.

【77】Symptoms in either type include， in addition to mouth-breathing secondary to nasal obstruction， intense irritation in nose and eyes， sneezing， excessive nasal discharge and watering of eyes. Local ex-amination reveals that the nasal mucosa is pale/bluish and swollen. Nasal airway is diminished and there is watery nasal discharge. Con-junctiva is congested. There may also be bronchospasm.

【78】Nasal polyposis， meaning aa pedunculated， hypertrophied edema-tous nasal mucosa supposedly due to allergy， infection or both， is an important cause of nasal obstruction and mouth breathing. Ac-companying symptoms include persistent cold， sneezing， headache， hyposmia and postnasal drip.

【79】A foreign body in the nose (say peas， beans， crayon， beads， buttons， pieces of pencil or plastic， maggots， etc.) produces inflammatory re-action. Nasal obstruction may lead to mouth-breathing.

【82】**Deviated Nasal Septum**

【83】Deviated nasal septum (DNS)， when gross， may cause unilateral or bilateral nasal obstruction and mouth-breathing together with dryness of mouth and pharynx， recurrent attacks of cold， headache and facial pain， epistaxis， cosmetic deformity， anosmia and local tenderness due to pres-sure on anterior ethmoidal nerve， the so-called Studer's syndrome.

【84】**Mouth-Breathing as a Habit**

【85】Not infrequently， children (so do adults) get into the habit of mouth-breathing without any evidence of nasal obstruction or any reasonable cause.

【89】By the term， nystagmus， is meant involuntary rapid movements(horizontal， vertical， rotatory， or mixed) of the eyeball， usually causing no or little disturbance to the subject. The most common form of nys-tagmus seen in pediatric practice is related to visual defects. As many as 22 out of the 40 infants and children with nystagmus seen by me during the recent months turned out to have one or the other defect of vision as the cause.

【90】History should ascertain whether nystagmus has been there since early in-fancy or it occurred later. Is it spontaneous， or follows certain stimulus， say when the subject tries to fix at an object placed in an extreme lateral position (end-position nystagmus) or， when the eye attempts at fixing a stationary object while the subject is in a moving vehicle (optokinetic nystagmus)? Does the individual suffer from a visual problem? Is he on antiepileptic drugs， or such agents as aspirin or diphenoxylate hydrochloride? Does the patient have nodding spasm? Any history of associated nausea， vomiting， dizziness， ataxia or tremors?

【91】Physical examination should， in particular， focus on vision and CNS besides routine examination. Is there any evidence of albinism?

Learning was severely impaired (z-score of -4.2)， delayed free recall revealed a z-score of -2.8， however， recognition performance was in the nor-mal range (z-score of 0.3). **To summarize the patient showed severely impaired language perfor-mance， some problems with motor speech， but intact recognition. 【7】**5.4 Semantic dementia**

【8】**5.4.1 Clinical core features**

【9】**The clinical features of SD are impairments in confrontation naming， single-word comprehension， and one of following three： poor object or person knowledge， surface dyslexia， spared repetition， and spared motor speech. The diagnostic criteria for SD can be found in Table 5.5. Gorno-Tempini et al. 通用删除7(英):<u>(2011)</u> stated that for the diagnosis of SD both of the following core features mustt be present：： impaired confrontation naming and impaired single-word comprehension. At least three of the following other diagnostic features must also be present： impaired object knowledge (particularly for low frequency or low-familiarity items)， surface dyslexia or dysgraphia， spared repetition， spared speech production (grammar and motor speech).**

【10】**5.4.2 Cognitive impairments in semantic dementia**

【11】**The impairment in confrontation naming and reading is not due to impaired access to the phonological word form but due to a loss of the recognition of the meaning of the perceived objects. Thus it is caused by a progressive deterioration of the semantic memory store. In one of the first systematic papers on SD， Hodges， Spatt， and Patterson 通用删除7(英):<u>(1999)</u> compared two patients with this clinical syndrome and one patient with corticobasal degeneration or corticobasal syndrome(CBD/CBS) . In the nonverbal functional semantic task， the two patients with SD scored at chance level， however， the patient with CBD scored almost in the normal range. All three patients were impaired with respect to real tool use， but only the patient with CBD/CBS exhibited impairments when using the new tools. How should these results be interpreted? Patients with SD do have problems recognizing objects； therefore they demonstrate impaired performances in the first three tasks. They do not have problems with the apprehension of spatial relations， however， the function of the new tools could easily be understood after observ-ing their spatial configuration. In more traditional terms， patients with SD suf-fer from a kind of visual agnosia， but not as a disconnection syndrome， but because the storage of world knowledge is impaired. 【23】**5.4.3 Phonological working memory impairment in semantic dementia**

【24】**Returning to the seminal work of Alan Baddeley， cognitive neuropsycholo-gists measure phonological working memory using the digit span tasks. During the last four decades， it has become apparent that the phonological buffer and the phonological loop are not only influenced by formal charac-teristics of the word sounds (compare Section 5.5. on lPPA which is dis-cussed later) but also by comprehension of the words and their semantic relations. Storing sequences of words in the phonological working memory shows a similar course as the learning of wordlists revealing an impact of proactive and retroactive interference. High frequency words and words with high imageability can be retained better than infrequent words or abstract words. The maximal pseudoword span is smaller than the maximal word span， arguing for an impact of the meaning of the word for its reproduction.**

【25】**As argued earlier， a progressive loss of word meaning together with an unim-paired phonological word lexicon is a major problem of SD. This can be used for differential diagnosis because the two other PPAs do not show problems in single-word comprehension (at least not in the beginning of the disease). The impact of understanding the meaning of words on verbal working memory per-formance may also be even more specific. Brain atrophy in SD is concentrated in the anterior and inferior temporal lobe， whereas brain atrophy in lPPA is focused in the parietotemporal junction. The former brain region is related to the meaning objects， whereas the latter region is related to the understanding and use of numbers and calculation. Jefferies， Patterson， Jones， Bateman， and Lambon Ralph 通用删除7(英):<u>(2004)</u> published a paper on verbal short-term memory in SD based on the performance of four patients. They were able to show that the patients were unimpaired in digit span forwards. Even using higher numbers (above nine) SD patients did not differ from healthy controls in repeating digit span sequences. However， matching words of similar frequency with numbers revealed that SD patients were impaired in comparison to healthy controls. The severity of the impairment increased with low frequent， low imageable (abstract) words， and decreased for frequent words. The deficit in word comprehension had a direct impact on the word span， which insinuates that the phonological buffer is endorsed by the semantic structure of the to-be-remembered items.**

【26】**Further AD patients suffer from an increasing loss of semantic memory， although the onset of this only occurs in later phases. Several studies have shown that AD patients present deficits in semantic word fluency but not so much in phonological word fluency . If this is correct， then AD patients should also show a rela-tive decline in their ability to repeat low imageable words compared to high imageable words. 【30】Paraphilic Disorders

【31】Overview

【32】**Paraphilic Disorders**

【33】The paraphilic diagnoses involve variations in the object or conditions of sexual fantasies， urges， and/or behavior. For any of the paraphilic diagnoses， the symp-tom presentation must have persisted for at least 6 months. For those Paraphilic Disorders that involve nonconsenting partners (and are consequently illegal)， the diagnosis is made if the client has acted on the urges and/or if he or she experiences distress or interpersonal impairment in relation to the urges. For those Paraphilic Disorders that do not involve potentially illegal behavior， the diagnoses are usually made based on the presence of clinical distress or psycho-social problems .

【34】The specific Paraphilic Disorders listed in the DSM-5  include Exhibitionism (exposure of genitals)， Fetishism (use of nonliving objects)， Frotteurism (touchingg and rubbing against a nonconsenting person)， Pedophilia (focus on prepubescent children)， Sexual Masochism (receiving humiliation or suffering)， Sexual Sadism (inflicting humiliation or suffering)， Transvestic Fetishism (cross-dressing)， and Voyeurism (observing sexual activity). An Unspecified Paraphilic Disorder category exists for diagnosing people with attachments to less frequently encountered situations or objects.

【35】It is essential to distinguish the nonpathological use of fantasy， behavior， or objects in consensual sexual relations from Paraphilic Disorders. In these disorders， there must be clinically significant distress or psychosocial impair-ment， such as being unable to perform sexually in the absence of the paraphilic material， legal complications， interference with intimate relations， and other dysfunctional behaviors .

【36】删除3:<u>A s s e s s m e n t</u>

【37】A complete assessment of individuals with paraphilic disorders should include a full history and a comprehensive mental status evaluation as well as a psycho-sexual history. Comorbidity with other mental disorders is quite frequent with poorer chances for recovery. Common coexisting mental disorders include：anxiety， depressive， bipolar， antisocial personality，conduct， substance use， and hypersexuality disorders as well as psychosocial impairment . It is important to note that most individuals with paraphilic disorders do not seek and/or are resistant to treatment and have a high chance of relapse .

【38】Developmental factors that play a role in the development of these dis-orders include a dysfunctional home environment， quite often suggesting an emotionally distant parent or one that lacks nurturance and engages in intrusive behavior (i.e.， name calling and belittling). Family problems are often present and contribute to poor social skills， distorted ideas of sexual intimacy，and low self-esteem. Physical abuse is more common than sexual abuse for male sex offenders， with one study showing that 40% of men who sexually abuse boys have been sexually abused themselves .

【39】Assessment tools include broad-based personality inventories. The follow-ing is a listing of scales that can help with diagnosis in this population： (a) Millon Clinical Multiaxial Inventory ， (b) Minnesota Multiphasic Personality Inventory ，(c) Beck Depression Inventory ，(d) State Trait Anxiety Inventory， (e) Abel Assessment for Sexual Interest ， (f) Aggres-sive Sexual Behavior Inventory ， and (g) the Sexual Arousability Inventory . Physiological testing is also used to assess sexual arousal to stimuli； however； there has been limited use of this tool. Treatment is multifaceted including individual， group， and family counseling， medication， education， and self-help groups.

【40】Cultural Considerations

【41】Paraphilias are culturally determined and as a result， prevalence and definition change over time and place . Sexual practices are related to culture through religious rituals and moral beliefs. Legal and religious systems heavily influence what constitutes sexual deviance. Within a culture the attitudes toward the opposite sex may contribute to the development of paraphilias. The extent to which a society is open or closed， individualistic or collectivistic in terms of sexuality will determine in part how the culture defines deviant sexual behavior. A number of culture-bound paraphilias， such as dhat and koro， that are recognized in Southeast Asian and the median subcontinent of India can be found in the glossary of cultural concepts of distress in the DSM-5. Also， most of the research shows that prevalence is higher for all paraphilias among males. Our limited knowledge of cross-culturalLpaiaphilic behaviors is due to the secrecy and illegality of many of these practices. There is a considerable lack of epidemiological data that is considered valid and reli-able. Despite this problem， it appears that some cultures consider fewer sexual practices as deviant compared to Western cultures. Further research on different cultural practices is necessary for our full understanding of paraphilias.

In fibrofol-liculoma， thin cords of epithelial cells， at first undifferentiated， emerge from infundibula and curve downward gently in a path that parallels the long axis of a follicle. The cords， and the course of them， resemble “man-tles” of epithelial cells that in normal skin develop into sebaceous cells， lobules， and ducts. A striking fenestrated pattern results from anastomosis of cords of mantle-like epithelium. The stromal element of fibrofolliculoma encompasses the entire epithelial component of it. In contrast， a trichodis-coma is not centered around a hair follicle， but is encircled by folliculo-sebaceous units， the latter consisting of elongated lobules that resemble mitts or hands of bananas. The dominant component of trichodiscoma at first glance， unlike that in fibrofolliculoma， is stromal rather than epithelial. That stroma consists mostly of collagen bundles that range from delicate fibers to discrete ribbons. Associated with collagen bundles arrayed hap-hazardly is an increased number of fibrocytes， many of them pyramidal， in concert with increased amounts of mucin peppered by mast cells. In short， at their extremes， pure fibrofolliculoma and pure trichodiscoma differ his-topathologically from one another. Even in these polar circumstances， how-ever， the constituents of the epithelial and stromal components of trichodis-coma are virtually the same.

Throughout the skin， mantles arepresent in association with hair follicles， both vellus and termi-nal types. They are situated at the junction of infundibulum and isthmus， the precise site of entry of future sebaceous ducts. Early in life， sebaceous lobules that are present at birth wither and disappear， and in their stead appear undifferentiated cells of mantles. Those cells lie dormant until thev are awakened at puberty. It seems that after puberty mantles have a cycle that takes them from an undifferentiated state into a differentiated one as manifested by numerous large sebaceous lobules and sebaceous ducts， only to regress again into an undifferentiated cloak-like (or arm-like) configura-tion at the sides of follicles.
